description: Stationnements vélos sur le territoire de Cap Atlantique is a dataset listed in Cap Atlantique - Open Data, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by Cap Atlantique. Stationnements vélo présents sur le territoire de Cap Atlantique. Coverage: Cap Atlantique (Loire-Atlantique). The portal files it under Mobilité. Its keywords are abri. The portal shows 370 records. The portal flags it as a time series. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2022-10-04 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Licence Ouverte v2.0 (Etalab). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support cycling and walking network and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-data-capatlantique-fr-portal.
